# ML-DSA Signature Demo

> A live demonstrator of ML-DSA post-quantum digital signatures (NIST FIPS 204).
> Generate key pairs, sign and verify text or files, and read sizes and timings
> measured at runtime. Runs locally: Next.js frontend + FastAPI backend.

## Pages

- [Home](/): interactive keygen / sign / verify tool for ML-DSA-44, ML-DSA-65 and ML-DSA-87, plus a measured comparison against Ed25519 and RSA-2048.
- [About](/about): what the demo proves, how it is built, and which libraries implement the cryptography.
- [Privacy](/privacy): this demo stores nothing.

## Key facts

- Standard: NIST FIPS 204 (Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Standard), published 2024-08-13.
- Algorithm: pure ML-DSA, hedged variant, empty context.
- Signature sizes (FIPS 204 Table 2): ML-DSA-44 = 2420 B, ML-DSA-65 = 3309 B, ML-DSA-87 = 4627 B.
- Cryptography: pqcrypto 1.0.0 (ML-DSA), cryptography 50.0.2 (Ed25519, RSA-2048). No hand-rolled crypto.

## API (local backend, http://127.0.0.1:8000)

- GET /api/health, GET /api/params
- POST /api/keys, POST /api/signatures, POST /api/verifications, POST /api/benchmarks
